title: Conditional κ = 0.00312277313 (+0.00000012269 over #5786)
body:
Compose the released [PR5786 asynchronous hubs](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5786), its thirteen [PR5774 retained native copies](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5774), and Joel Pulikkan's original R22 block. The complete conditional saving rises from **0.00312265044 to 0.00312277313**, a gain of **0.00000012269**. The raw crossing is strictly inside `(0.00312277315303,0.00312277315304)`. This claims the verified composition, with full predecessor credit. The earlier PR5774-only checkpoint is superseded and is not a separate contribution.

The new compatibility proof checks the exact rational transfer matrix of each of the eight R22 edits. The edits preserve every external COPY value, even though scalar operations inside a block are reordered. All 23 COPY events, including thirteen retained native copies, keep their logical inputs. Existing chart 1090 is reused only after its basis is checked exactly. The literal source matches, changed helper endpoints and complete invoice are explicit in the [package and proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/582c6334f474b5ea576b518a9497ae9961c620ac/research/p104-copy-block-composition/README.md), [compatibility certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/582c6334f474b5ea576b518a9497ae9961c620ac/research/p104-copy-block-composition/COMPATIBILITY.json) and [full result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/582c6334f474b5ea576b518a9497ae9961c620ac/research/p104-copy-block-composition/RESULT.json).

The complete caller has **13444 productive targets, 66924 paid calls and rank surplus 760**. Every native copy, query, adapter, normalizer, scalar operation, owned lifetime, route and idle remains charged. Both rational moment engines, the finite compiler, 54 strict outer rows and four functional conditions pass. The published saving is 2.303e-11 to 2.304e-11 below its raw ceiling. The fixed R22 canonical-chart optimum from PR5772 still applies to that block; joint changes to other contracts remain open.

Validation: all four registered Python 3.12 commands pass in 438.77 seconds. They check all 795 scalar input columns and 632025 coefficients, separate transpose columns, 2924 native maps with absolute phases, 27 owned lifetimes, 208 main adapters, 1124 helper normalizers and the full physical caller. Nine word/caller/invoice controls, a wrong native phase, a wrong scalar transfer and three actual frozen-source corruptions reject. Committed bytes/modes and official export pass. The read-only, Git-free export passes both scripts under -I -O -W error -B with empty PATH in 128.83 and 0.19 seconds; all 24 exported files keep their bytes and modes. See the [validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/582c6334f474b5ea576b518a9497ae9961c620ac/research/p104-copy-block-composition/VALIDATION.md).

Run `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-copy-block-composition`.

Limits: this is a small conditional gain. All five framework assumptions remain; no large uniform word or rounded multiplier is materialized. The separate 102-operation block in Discussion5125 has been requested but remains reserved until its public artifact is released; it is not reconstructed here. The active forward/nonnested-copy and whole-target temporal-cut searches remain separate. Full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent scientific acceptance remain pending. No merge, closure or selected-frontier change.

Base and refreshed main: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19202093). Exact immediate source: PR5786 at `6b936acd68a7e0f9062037900f0fe9bc4b6fdd25`; R22 edits: PR5739 at `b93d749a0a895d260e87887170af5162bda461a4`. Credit Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled, PR5786/5774/5751, flyingviper PR5718, Cinna Davis, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and every retained P104/native/BIT predecessor. New integration and compatibility proof: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
